methods.description: When possible, rewrite a fraction with power-of-ten denominator and use place value.
Divide numerator by denominator and keep exact recurring notation when needed.
Write the terminating decimal over its place-value denominator and simplify.
Convert the fraction/mixed number to a decimal if needed, multiply by100 and give percentage form.
Divide by100 to obtain a decimal, or write percentage over100 and simplify.
